about.valuesText: Professionalism, Leadership, Commitment (to quality and standards), Fun and Interaction.
about.heading: Turning Knowledge into Value, Shaping Tomorrow's Leaders
about.description: Established in 2017, KRONS Training and Consulting is a Mozambican-based corporate training provider, business consulting, HR consulting (Payroll, Head Hunting and Labour Supply). We specialize in tailored in-house training programs designed to enhance workforce productivity, safety, and operational efficiency across key industries, including logistics, mining, oil & gas, and NGOs. We are also specialized on ISO 9001 (QMS) consulting and Auditing. Our expert-led courses combine local industry knowledge with international best practices, ensuring that businesses in Mozambique gain a competitive edge through skills development, compliance training, and team performance enhancement.

aboutVisual.imageAlt: Business environment representing growth and development
aboutVisual.visionText: We aim to obtain market recognition for quality and professionalism of our services while we become the leading corporate training provider in Mozambique, recognized for innovation, reliability, and transformative learning experiences.
aboutVisual.missionText: Based on the essence of continuous improvement, our mission is to provide our services at a high level and performing high quality standards. We aim to deliver high-impact, customized training solutions that drive organizational growth, improve workplace safety, and foster professional excellence across Mozambique's key economic sectors.
